name: SoundTest_Run
evidence: Unreferenced debug sound test screen: number = wRam_C0D6:C0E5 in hex; A plays it as music (stub 00:20B2), B as sound effect (00:20AC), Start stops (00:20C4 / 00:20BE with bc=0), Select ends; never executed

name: SoundTest_Loop
evidence: Per-frame loop: 00:044B, Joypad_UpdateIdleFrames (7D:7BA4)/7BC1, call JoypadDispatch with Table_SoundTest_Buttons

name: Table_SoundTest_Buttons
evidence: JoypadDispatch inline table: A -> SoundTest_OnA (MUSIC), B -> SoundTest_OnB (SOUND), Select -> SoundTest_OnSelect (END), Start -> SoundTest_OnStart (STOP), none -> SoundTest_Idle

name: SoundTest_Idle
evidence: SoundTest_UpdateHoldTimer, then D-pad with repeat -> SoundTest_HandleDpad, loop

name: SoundTest_OnA
evidence: A: C=wRam_C0E5, B=wRam_C0D6 (sound id), SVBK=1, call 00:20B2 (music start stub -> 04:4287 SoundDrv_PlayMusic)

name: SoundTest_OnB
evidence: B: same id, call 00:20AC (sound effect stub -> 04:41C0 SoundDrv_PlaySfx)

name: SoundTest_OnSelect
evidence: Select: stops music (00:20C4, bc=0) and effects (00:20BE, bc=0), ticks 00:20A6, fades out 4F:4370, returns A=1 (leave test)

name: SoundTest_OnStart
evidence: Start ('STOP'): 00:20C4 and 00:20BE with bc=0 (stop music, stop all effects), stay in the test

name: SoundTest_HandleDpad
evidence: Up/Down change the high byte wRam_C0D6, Left/Right the low byte wRam_C0E5 (by 4 after the hold timer passes $3C); redraws SoundTest_DrawNumber

name: SoundTest_DrawNumber
evidence: Draws '【' + four full-width hex digits (wRam_C0D6 hi, wRam_C0E5 lo) + '】' from String_SoundTest_HexChars and uploads to VRAM $8E00

name: String_SoundTest_HexChars
evidence: 16 full-width hex characters '０'-'９','Ａ'-'Ｆ' (2 bytes each, no NUL) indexed by nibble in SoundTest_DrawNumber

name: SoundTest_UpdateHoldTimer
evidence: Auto-repeat timer: resets wRam_C0E7 when hJoyHeld changes (wRam_C0E8), else increments it (saturating)
